question: One of the largest dams of the world, Hirakud Dam, is built across the _______ river.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahanadi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The dam is located across the Mahanadi river near the town of Sambalpur in the state of Orissa.
 
• The length of its main section is about 4.8 kilometers and the whole dam spans 25.8 kilometers.
 
• The dam was started in 1957 and is one of the first major multipurpose river valley projects started after India's independence.
